# Load and inspect data from X to 2008
```{r}
#add block purpose and ECHO parameters to each chunk

library(data.table)
library(dplyr) #data format manipulation
library(janitor)
library(ncdf4) #read nc files (3 and 4 type)
library(purrr) #avoiding loops to extract data from vectors and then build abiotic/ nutrients tables
library(readr) #write out or read in tables
library(stringr) #similar to purrr, really great for name/ characteristic changes
library(tibble) #creating tables
library(tidyr)


# Run from the mytilus_ec project root
file_path <- "../data/raw/nccos_chem_data.txt"

stopifnot(file.exists(file_path))

# Inspect the file before parsing
file.info(file_path)$size / 1024^2

# First 12 lines
readLines(file_path, n = 12, warn = FALSE)
```
